304: func validateSmokeRun(p smokePrepared, discovery smokeDiscovery, selection smokeSelection, response smokeRunResponse, proc pprocess.Result) ([]SmokeEvidence, []SmokeIssue, []SmokeTestResult, error) {
305: 	if response.SchemaVersion != 1 || response.ProtocolVersion != p.Manifest.ProtocolVersion || response.HarnessID != p.Manifest.Harness.ID || response.RunID == "" {
306: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_identity", "evidence", "run identity does not match manifest/discovery", "Inspect the external run response.", nil)
307: 	}
308: 	if response.ScopeKind != selection.Kind || strings.Join(response.Scope, ",") != strings.Join(selection.IDs, ",") {
309: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_scope", "evidence", "reported scope does not match the request", "Fix the harness scope identity.", nil)
310: 	}
311: 	c := response.Counts
312: 	if c.Total < 0 || c.Passed < 0 || c.Failed < 0 || c.Skipped < 0 || c.Errors < 0 || c.Passed+c.Failed+c.Skipped+c.Errors != c.Total {
313: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_counts", "evidence", "result counts are inconsistent", "Fix the harness count summary.", nil)
314: 	}
315: 	if response.DurationMs < 0 || len(response.Evidence) == 0 {
316: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_missing", "evidence", "duration or evidence identity is missing", "Emit complete protocol-v1 evidence.", nil)
317: 	}
318: 	expected := expectedSmokeTests(discovery, selection)
319: 	actual := make([]string, 0, len(response.Tests))
320: 	statusCounts := SmokeCountsWire{}
321: 	for _, test := range response.Tests {
322: 		if test.ID == "" {
323: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_tests", "evidence", "run contains an empty test identity", "Return every executed discovered test identity.", nil)
324: 		}
325: 		actual = append(actual, test.ID)
326: 		switch test.Status {
327: 		case "passed":
328: 			statusCounts.Passed++
329: 		case "failed":
330: 			statusCounts.Failed++
331: 		case "skipped":
332: 			statusCounts.Skipped++
333: 		case "error":
334: 			statusCounts.Errors++
335: 		default:
336: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_tests", "evidence", "run contains an unsupported test status", "Use passed, failed, skipped, or error.", nil)
337: 		}
338: 	}
339: 	statusCounts.Total = len(response.Tests)
340: 	sort.Strings(expected)
341: 	sort.Strings(actual)
342: 	if strings.Join(expected, "\x00") != strings.Join(actual, "\x00") || statusCounts != c {
343: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_tests", "evidence", "executed test identities/statuses do not match discovery and counts", "Run exactly the selected discovered tests and return their identities.", nil)
344: 	}
345: 	var evidence []SmokeEvidence
346: 	for _, item := range response.Evidence {
347: 		root := p.RunsRoot
348: 		if item.Kind == "issue" {
349: 			root = p.IssuesRoot
350: 		}
351: 		full := item.Path
352: 		if !filepath.IsAbs(full) {
353: 			full = filepath.Join(p.HarnessRoot, filepath.FromSlash(full))
354: 		}
355: 		resolved, err := canonicalFileInside(root, full)
356: 		if err != nil {
357: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_path", "evidence", "evidence path escapes or is missing", "Keep evidence inside declared roots.", err)
358: 		}
359: 		info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
360: 		if err != nil {
361: 			return nil, nil, nil, err
362: 		}
363: 		hash, err := hashFile(resolved)
364: 		if err != nil {
365: 			return nil, nil, nil, err
366: 		}
367: 		if item.SHA256 != "" && !strings.EqualFold(item.SHA256, hash) {
368: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_hash", "evidence", "evidence hash mismatch", "Restore immutable run evidence or rerun smoke.", nil)
369: 		}
370: 		if !strings.Contains(filepath.Base(resolved), response.RunID) && item.Kind != "issue" {
371: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_run", "evidence", "evidence path does not identify the reported run", "Use run-ID-addressed evidence.", nil)
372: 		}
373: 		evidence = append(evidence, SmokeEvidence{Kind: item.Kind, Path: resolved, SHA256: hash, Size: info.Size(), ModifiedAt: info.ModTime().UTC()})
374: 	}
375: 	issues := append([]SmokeIssue(nil), response.Issues...)
376: 	failedTests := make(map[string]struct{}, c.Failed+c.Errors)
377: 	for _, test := range response.Tests {
378: 		if test.Status == "failed" || test.Status == "error" {
379: 			failedTests[test.ID] = struct{}{}
380: 		}
381: 	}
382: 	filedTests := make(map[string]struct{}, len(issues))
383: 	for i := range issues {
384: 		if issues[i].ID == "" || (issues[i].Status != "open" && issues[i].Status != "resolved") {
385: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_identity", "evidence", "issue identity/status is invalid", "Emit open or resolved issue metadata.", nil)
386: 		}
387: 		full := issues[i].Path
388: 		if !filepath.IsAbs(full) {
389: 			full = filepath.Join(p.HarnessRoot, filepath.FromSlash(full))
390: 		}
391: 		resolved, err := canonicalFileInside(p.IssuesRoot, full)
392: 		if err != nil || !strings.Contains(filepath.Base(resolved), issues[i].ID) {
393: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_path", "evidence", "issue path is missing, escaping, or mismatched", "Use an issue-ID-addressed file under the issues root.", err)
394: 		}
395: 		issues[i].Path = resolved
396: 		if _, failed := failedTests[issues[i].TestID]; failed && issues[i].Status == "open" {
397: 			filedTests[issues[i].TestID] = struct{}{}
398: 		}
399: 		if issues[i].Status == "open" && (issues[i].TestID == "" || issues[i].Severity == "" || issues[i].Title == "" || issues[i].Summary == "" || issues[i].Theory == "" || issues[i].Evidence == "" || issues[i].Action == "") {
400: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_detail", "evidence", "open issue metadata is incomplete", "For every open issue emit test_id, severity, title, summary, theory, evidence, and action.", nil)
401: 		}
402: 	}
403: 	for testID := range failedTests {
404: 		if _, ok := filedTests[testID]; !ok {
405: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_missing", "evidence", "failed test has no detailed open issue: "+testID, "File and return one detailed issue for every failed or errored test.", nil)
406: 		}
407: 	}
408: 	if proc.ExitCode != 0 && c.Failed+c.Errors == 0 {
409: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_process_unexplained", "process", "non-zero process exit has no matching failed evidence", "Inspect external evidence before retrying.", nil)
410: 	}
411: 	return evidence, issues, append([]SmokeTestResult(nil), response.Tests...), nil
412: }

414: func expectedSmokeTests(discovery smokeDiscovery, selection smokeSelection) []string {
415: 	testBySuite := map[string][]string{}
416: 	for _, suite := range discovery.Suites {
417: 		testBySuite[suite.ID] = append([]string(nil), suite.Tests...)
418: 	}
419: 	var out []string
420: 	switch selection.Kind {
421: 	case "test":
422: 		out = append(out, selection.IDs...)
423: 	case "suite":
424: 		for _, suite := range selection.IDs {
425: 			out = append(out, testBySuite[suite]...)
426: 		}
427: 	case "level":
428: 		for _, level := range discovery.Levels {
429: 			if len(selection.IDs) > 0 && level.ID == selection.IDs[0] {
430: 				for _, suite := range level.Suites {
431: 					out = append(out, testBySuite[suite]...)
432: 				}
433: 			}
434: 		}
435: 	}
436: 	return out
437: }

439: func (s Service) commitSmoke(p smokePrepared, result SmokeResult) (SmokeResult, error) {
440: 	content := RenderSmoke(result)
441: 	if findings := ValidateSmokeContent(content); len(findings) > 0 {
442: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, smokeError("smoke_artifact_validation", "validation", findings[0].Problem, findings[0].Suggestion, nil))
443: 	}
444: 	path, err := ArtifactPath(s.root, p.Sprint, StageSmoke)
445: 	if err != nil {
446: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, err)
447: 	}
448: 	if err := atomicWriteFile(path, []byte(content)); err != nil {
449: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, smokeError("smoke_persistence", "persistence", "smoke summary could not be committed", "The previous valid summary was preserved.", err))
450: 	}
451: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, p.Sprint)
452: 	if err != nil {
453: 		result.Reconciliation = true
454: 		return result, smokeError("smoke_reconciliation", "reconciliation", "smoke.md committed but flow state could not be loaded", "Reconcile flow state by rerunning smoke.", err)
455: 	}
456: 	now := s.now().UTC()
457: 	evidenceID := ""
458: 	if len(result.Evidence) > 0 {
459: 		evidenceID = result.Evidence[0].SHA256
460: 	}
461: 	artifactDigest := hashBytes([]byte(content))
462: 	identityRefs := smokeIdentityReferences(p, result)
463: 	inputFingerprint, _ := refreshEvidenceFingerprint(identityRefs)
464: 	refs := make([]EvidenceReference, 0, len(result.Evidence))
465: 	for _, evidence := range result.Evidence {
466: 		refs = append(refs, EvidenceReference{Kind: evidence.Kind, Path: evidence.Path, Digest: evidence.SHA256})
467: 	}
468: 	var override *DiagnosticOverride
469: 	if result.ReviewOverride {
470: 		override = &DiagnosticOverride{Requested: true, Confirmed: true, Rationale: result.OverrideRationale, RequestedAt: now, ReviewFingerprint: result.ReviewFingerprint, ReviewVerdict: string(result.ReviewVerdict)}
471: 	}
472: 	active := (*VerificationAttempt)(nil)
473: 	if state.Smoke != nil {
474: 		active = state.Smoke.ActiveAttempt
475: 	}
476: 	state.Smoke = &SmokeStageState{Status: result.Status, Verdict: result.Verdict, Path: ArtifactRelPath(p.Sprint, StageSmoke), LastRunAt: &now, ReviewFingerprint: result.ReviewFingerprint, SmokeFingerprint: artifactDigest, ArtifactDigest: artifactDigest, InputFingerprint: inputFingerprint, RunID: result.RunID, AuthorRunID: result.AuthorRunID, AuthorModel: result.AuthorModel, AuthorChangedPaths: append([]string(nil), result.AuthorChangedPaths...), CoverageMapping: result.CoverageMapping, EvidenceID: evidenceID, ReviewOverride: result.ReviewOverride, Diagnostics: result.Diagnostics, Issues: append([]SmokeIssue(nil), result.Issues...), Evidence: refs, Override: override, ActiveAttempt: active, LastComplete: &SmokeCompletion{Verdict: result.Verdict, Artifact: ArtifactRelPath(p.Sprint, StageSmoke), ArtifactDigest: artifactDigest, InputFingerprint: inputFingerprint, CompletedAt: now, RunID: result.RunID, AuthorRunID: result.AuthorRunID, AuthorModel: result.AuthorModel, AuthorChangedPaths: append([]string(nil), result.AuthorChangedPaths...), CoverageMapping: result.CoverageMapping, EvidenceID: evidenceID, Evidence: identityRefs, Issues: append([]SmokeIssue(nil), result.Issues...), Override: override}}
477: 	if err := SaveFlowState(s.root, p.Sprint, state); err != nil {
478: 		result.Reconciliation = true
479: 		return result, smokeError("smoke_reconciliation", "reconciliation", "smoke.md committed but flow state update failed", "Reconcile flow state by rerunning smoke.", err)
480: 	}
481: 	return result, nil
482: }

484: func RenderSmoke(r SmokeResult) string {

487: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Smoke Context\n\nProject: `%s`\nSprint: `%s`\nArtifact: `%s`\n\n", r.Project, r.Sprint, r.Artifact)
488: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Review Gate\n\nReview verdict: `%s`\nReview fingerprint: `%s`\nDiagnostic override: `%t`\nOverride rationale: %s\n\n", r.ReviewVerdict, r.ReviewFingerprint, r.ReviewOverride, printable(r.OverrideRationale))
489: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Harness And Protocol\n\nHarness: `%s`\nProtocol: `%s`\n\n", r.Harness, r.Protocol)

497: 	}
498: 	b.WriteString("\n")
499: 	if mapping := r.CoverageMapping; mapping != nil {
500: 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Coverage Mapping\n\nComplete: `%t`\nRequired coverage: `%s`\nRationale: %s\n\n", mapping.Complete, strings.Join(mapping.RequiredCoverage, "`, `"), printable(mapping.Rationale))
501: 		for _, requirement := range mapping.Requirements {

507: 		}
508: 		b.WriteString("\n")
509: 	}
510: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Selected Scope And Rationale\n\nScope kind: `%s`\nScope: `%s`\nRationale: %s\nDuration class: `%s`\nCost class: `%s`\nDiagnostic only: `%t`\n\n", printable(r.ScopeKind), printable(r.Scope), printable(r.ScopeRationale), printable(r.DurationClass), printable(r.CostClass), r.DiagnosticOnly)
511: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Preconditions And Environment\n\nPrerequisites: %s\nEnvironment: bounded allowlist; values not persisted\nEvidence roots: `%s`\nEffective timeout: `%s` (source `%s`)\n\n", printable(strings.Join(r.Prerequisites, "; ")), printable(strings.Join(r.EvidenceRoots, ", ")), r.EffectiveTimeout, printable(r.TimeoutSource))
512: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Safe Invocation\n\nArgv: `%s`\n\n", printable(r.SafeArgv))
513: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Run Evidence\n\nRun ID: `%s`\nTotal: `%d`\nPassed: `%d`\nFailed: `%d`\nSkipped: `%d`\nErrors: `%d`\nDuration: `%s`\nRuntime: `%s`\nModel: `%s`\n\n", printable(r.RunID), r.Counts.Total, r.Counts.Passed, r.Counts.Failed, r.Counts.Skipped, r.Counts.Errors, r.Duration, printable(r.Runtime), printable(r.Model))
514: 	if len(r.Tests) > 0 {
515: 		b.WriteString("Executed tests:\n")
516: 		for _, test := range r.Tests {
517: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s`: `%s`\n", test.ID, test.Status)
518: 		}
519: 		b.WriteString("\n")
520: 	}
521: 	b.WriteString("### External Evidence Identity And Links\n\n")
522: 	if len(r.Evidence) == 0 {
523: 		b.WriteString("- none (preflight classification)\n")
524: 	} else {
525: 		for _, e := range r.Evidence {
526: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` `%s` sha256 `%s` size `%d` modified `%s`\n", e.Kind, e.Path, e.SHA256, e.Size, e.ModifiedAt.Format(time.RFC3339))
527: 		}
528: 	}
529: 	b.WriteString("\n## Findings\n\n")
530: 	findings := 0
531: 	for _, issue := range r.Issues {
532: 		if issue.Status != "open" {
533: 			continue
534: 		}
535: 		findings++
536: 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "### `%s` — %s\n\n", issue.TestID, printable(issue.Title))
537: 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Severity: `%s`\n", printable(issue.Severity))
538: 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Observed: %s\n", printable(issue.Summary))
539: 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Working theory: %s\n", printable(issue.Theory))
540: 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Supporting evidence: %s\n", printable(issue.Evidence))
541: 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Next investigation: %s\n\n", printable(issue.Action))
542: 	}
543: 	if len(r.Diagnostics) == 0 && findings == 0 {
544: 		b.WriteString("- none\n")
545: 	} else {
546: 		for _, diagnostic := range r.Diagnostics {
547: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- %s\n", printable(diagnostic))
548: 		}
549: 	}
550: 	b.WriteString("\n## Open Issues\n\n")
551: 	open := false
552: 	for _, issue := range r.Issues {
553: 		if issue.Status == "open" {
554: 			open = true
555: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` (%s, test `%s`): `%s`\n", issue.ID, printable(issue.Severity), printable(issue.TestID), issue.Path)
556: 		}
557: 	}
558: 	if !open {
559: 		b.WriteString("- none\n")
560: 	}
561: 	b.WriteString("\n## Resolved Issues\n\n")
562: 	resolved := false
563: 	for _, issue := range r.Issues {
564: 		if issue.Status == "resolved" {
565: 			resolved = true
566: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` `%s`\n", issue.ID, issue.Path)
567: 		}
568: 	}
569: 	if !resolved {
570: 		b.WriteString("- none\n")
571: 	}
572: 	b.WriteString("\n## Mutation And Safety Check\n\nOnly smoke.md, flow-state.json, manifest-declared harness authoring paths, and manifest-declared external evidence roots were approved for mutation. Product source and governed sprint inputs were identity-checked before and after authoring.\n\n")
573: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Verdict And Next Action\n\nVerdict: `%s`\nNext action: %s\n", r.Verdict, printable(r.NextAction))
574: 	return b.String()
575: }

577: func ValidateSmokeContent(content string) []ValidationFinding {
578: 	var findings []ValidationFinding

reasoning_details.text:
PROVEN. The reproduction confirms:

- With `Request.Env = []string{}` (empty, non-nil) — the QA path's exact construction (`make([]string, 0, 0)`): child receives FULL parent environment. `ULTRAPLAN_SECRET_CANARY=leaked` visible in child.
- With `Request.Env = nil`: same leak.

Root cause: process.go:86 `cmd.Env = append([]string(nil), req.Env...)` → nil when len(Env)==0 → os/exec inherits parent env.

Impact paths:
1. **QA approved checks (deterministic, every run)**: qa_prompt.go:266-271 builds `env := make([]string, 0, len(descriptor.Environment))`; catalog descriptors have empty Environment (ApprovedQAChecks sets no Environment) → env is always empty non-nil → DirectRunner converts to nil → gofmt runs with the ENTIRE parent environment. Documented invariant "child env omits PATH while lookup happens parent-side" and "near-empty env" is false. Every parent env var (API keys, cloud credentials in env, tokens) is exposed to the child process environment. gofmt itself doesn't exfiltrate, but the policy's entire purpose is capability bounding; and the seam contract says "child env omits PATH". Any future approved check or any bug in gofmt/tooling reading env (e.g., GOPATH? no—gofmt doesn't; but e.g., a tool honoring GOFLAGS, GITHUB_TOKEN etc.) inherits it all.

2. **Smoke harness**: smokeEnvironment returns nil when NO allowlisted var has a non-empty value. Default allowlist includes PATH which is essentially always set, so default-config smoke runs get a 1..5-var env. But: operator configures `ULTRAPLAN_SMOKE_ENVIRONMENT=CUSTOM_VAR` (documented key) and CUSTOM_VAR unset/empty → env nil → harness gets full parent env including secrets — precisely what the allowlist was configured to prevent. That's an allowlist bypass triggered by exactly the configuration meant to tighten it. Also if Getenv func returns "" for all defaults (e.g., minimal container without HOME/TMPDIR/LANG/LC_ALL... PATH still set usually). The QA case alone makes this HIGH.

Also note the test suite gap: TestDirectRunnerExactEnvironmentCwdAndCapture only asserts presence of allowed var; nothing asserts exclusion of parent vars. So tests would not fail for this defect — confirmed by my repro failing on unmodified copied sources.

Severity: high (secret exposure to child processes + documented containment guarantee false). Confidence: high (proven by execution).

Fix direction: preserve emptiness:
```go
env := make([]string, len(req.Env))
copy(env, req.Env)
cmd.Env = env
```
make with len 0 returns non-nil empty slice. Regression test = my repro test.

**Defect #1 proven by execution**: `DirectRunner` leaks the full parent environment into children whenever `Request.Env` is empty/nil — violating the explicit-env-only contract. Both the QA path (`make([]string, 0, …)` with empty catalog env) and smoke path (nil return from `smokeEnvironment`) are affected.

Continuing with the remaining verification targets.

metadata.output:
## Git stage publication

`git.stage_completion` controls publication after a study task or sprint stage has produced valid canonical output and persisted its state. `commit` creates a local commit. `commit-and-push` also pushes the current branch, using its upstream when present or `git.remote` when no upstream exists. `off` preserves the working tree without Git mutation.

UltraPlan commits only paths owned by the completed stage. It leaves unrelated staged and unstaged changes alone. Execute is different because its recorded Git worktree belongs to one sprint; UltraPlan commits the complete worktree change set there. Agents remain prohibited from running `git add`, `git commit`, or `git push` themselves.

A push failure does not reopen a completed product stage. The command returns an error and leaves the local commit in place. Rerunning the stage pushes that commit without creating a duplicate. Git commands never prompt for credentials, and `git.push_timeout` bounds each push attempt.

## Smoke Configuration

Smoke configuration is resolved after manifest defaults and before command/TUI overrides. UltraPlan passes only named environment variables; values never appear in config output, JSON, Markdown, or TUI diagnostics. The built-in platform set is limited to `TMPDIR`, `LANG`, and `LC_ALL`; `PATH` and `HOME` are not forwarded by default. Add a manifest-declared name to `smoke.environment` only when the harness genuinely needs it. The real-harness test lane is opt-in with `ULTRAPLAN_REAL_SMOKE=1`; normal tests never launch it.

## Redaction

UltraPlan redacts sensitive-looking values in config, logs, diagnostics, status output, and health output. Do not place provider tokens in `ultraplan.yml`; prefer runtime-native environment or credential stores. Release evidence must not include provider tokens, full sensitive environment dumps, full prompts, full report bodies, or raw unsafe runtime payloads.
## Run-control retention and quota

The following settings participate in the normal default/YAML/environment/CLI
effective-configuration reporting and are safe to expose through redacted
diagnostics:

reasoning_details.text:
Docs say: "The built-in platform set is limited to TMPDIR, LANG, and LC_ALL; PATH and HOME are not forwarded by default." Code defaults include PATH and HOME (config.go:189, smoke_types.go:55). Confirmed CURRENT-CONTRACT divergence — the docs promise a tighter env set than shipped. Combined with defect #1, when the documented behavior is actually *attempted* by an operator (they might rely on HOME not being forwarded), reality diverges twice over.

Note the doc sentence also matters for defect #1's smoke path: docs tell operators PATH/HOME aren't forwarded; code forwards them by default; and if operator overrides `smoke.environment` to a custom name that's unset → full parent env inheritance. Triple divergence.

Also interesting: ULTRAPLAN_SMOKE_ENVIRONMENT is NOT in the env override table (config.go:132-136 lists only DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT, RUN_TIMEOUT, STDOUT_LIMIT, STDERR_LIMIT, CLEANUP_GRACE). The context pack claimed ENVIRONMENT was overridable via that key — it's not in this list. Maybe handled elsewhere (qaEnvOverrides? no). Let me check how smoke.environment gets set from env... Actually context pack said "overridable via ULTRAPLAN_SMOKE_{...,ENVIRONMENT} (config.go:132-136)". The actual file shows only 5 keys, no ENVIRONMENT. Minor discrepancy in context pack, not a code defect. Let me verify there's no other place handling ULTRAPLAN_SMOKE_ENVIRONMENT.

Now check app wiring for smokeSettings assembly + operation runner timeout parse.

Very telling: `TestDefaultSmokeEnvironmentPreservesInterpreterPath` asserts the smoke env allowlist works at the `smokeEnvironment` level — but because of defect #1, even if `smokeEnvironment` correctly excludes `UNDECLARED_SECRET`, the child process would still receive it via nil-env inheritance whenever the constructed env ends up empty... and actually wait: in this test, PATH/HOME/TMPDIR all have values → env non-nil → DirectRunner would copy 3 elements → non-nil → no inheritance. So in the DEFAULT configuration, smoke children get exactly [PATH HOME TMPDIR LANG LC_ALL] (those with values). The leak manifests when:
- QA checks (always — catalog env is empty), and
- smoke when all allowlisted values are empty/unset (rare in practice).

So the dominant real-world impact is the QA gofmt child receiving full parent env. The doc contract "PATH and HOME are not forwarded" is false at default too (they ARE forwarded by default per code + test pin) — separate documented-contract divergence.

Note the test name says "PreservesInterpreterPath" — deliberate choice to forward PATH/HOME, contradicting docs/configuration.md:230. The context pack flagged it as a neutral observation; per doctrine, docs are CURRENT-CONTRACT. The code contradicts an explicit written security-relevant promise ("PATH and HOME are not forwarded by default"). Observable bad outcome: operators/harness authors rely on HOME not being forwarded (e.g., harness reading ~/.netrc, ~/.gitcookies implicitly via tooling) — actual behavior forwards HOME. This is a genuine contract violation with security flavor, low-medium severity, high confidence.

Now let me check canonicalQAJSON quickly and then examine remaining smoke_test.go areas (manifest rejection matrix, discovery validation tests) to see coverage for things like env-name validation etc. Also double-check `validateSmokeManifest` environment names: validProtocolEnvName requires uppercase — but smokeEnvironment compares manifest names against settings.Environment entries case-sensitively; config validation (config.go:503) also validates smoke.environment names? Let me look at config.go:495-510 to see what charset config-side allows — if config allows lowercase and protocol requires uppercase, intersection just yields nothing. Not a defect.

One more candidate to scrutinize — **`prepareSmokeStatic` review-gate TOCTOU**: review validated via PrepareReview + content digest; then authorSmokeSuite runs an agent that can modify harness files within authoring paths; then discovery/run spawn. Fine.

**authorSmokeSuite**: does it spawn processes via DirectRunner? Let me check quickly — it's in another file (smoke_author.go?). grep for authorSmokeSuite.

Let me also verify **`decodeOneJSON` on huge stdout**: stdout capped by StdoutLimit (4MiB default) — decode cost bounded. OK.

**`hashFile` unbounded read** — evidence path inside runs/issues root; file size unchecked before ReadFile. targetIdentity has 64MiB bound; validateSmokeRun doesn't. A buggy/malicious harness writing a multi-GiB evidence file → ultraplan OOM during evidence validation. Also FIFO hang. part.text:
Review complete. All evidence gathered directly from source, tests, and an executed reproduction; baseline suites are green at the frozen commit.

# Findings — `process-execution`

## F1. HIGH / HIGH — `DirectRunner` leaks the entire parent environment into children when `Request.Env` is empty or nil

**Claim.** internal/platform/process/process.go:86 — `cmd.Env = append([]string(nil), req.Env...)` produces a **nil** slice whenever `len(req.Env) == 0`. Per `os/exec` semantics, `Cmd.Env == nil` means *inherit the parent's full environment*. The explicit-env-only invariant holds only when the caller passes ≥1 variable; it inverts exactly when the caller asks for the strictest possible env (empty).

**Observable bad outcome.**
- **QA approved checks — deterministic, every execution.** qa_prompt.go:266-271 builds `env := make([]string, 0, len(descriptor.Environment))`; catalog descriptors carry no `Environment`, so `env` is always empty-non-nil, then converted to nil at process.go:86. Every `gofmt -d` child receives the complete parent environment. The project's own deployment guidance (docs/configuration.md, Redaction section) says provider tokens live in the *runtime environment*, so the gofmt child — and any future approved-check executable — is handed exactly the secrets the "child env omits PATH" contract says it must not see.
- **Smoke harness — allowlist bypass.** `smokeEnvironment` (smoke_protocol.go:623-642) declares `var env []string` and appends nothing when every allowlisted name resolves empty/unset — precisely the configuration an operator sets following docs' "add a name only when the harness genuinely needs it." Result: the external harness inherits every parent secret, defeating the allowlist that exists to prevent that.

**Trigger.** Any `Run` call with `Env` nil or length 0. QA path triggers unconditionally; smoke path triggers whenever the resolved allowlist yields zero non-empty values.

**Evidence / reproduction.** Copied `process.go` + `process_unix.go` byte-identical into `/tmp/opencode/envrepro` and ran two tests asserting a parent sentinel (`ULTRAPLAN_SECRET_CANARY=leaked`) is absent from child stdout with `Env: []string{}` and with `Env: nil`. Both **FAIL**: child printed `"leaked-UNSET"`.

**Existing controls / counter-evidence searched.** No caller guards emptiness (grep: process.go:86 is the sole `Env` assignment in the package). Tests cannot catch it: `TestDirectRunnerExactEnvironmentCwdAndCapture` (process_test.go:15) asserts only *presence* of an explicitly passed var and shell-set `PWD`; `TestDefaultSmokeEnvironmentPreservesInterpreterPath` (smoke_test.go:108) tests `smokeEnvironment` in isolation, never the spawn. Nothing disproves the claim.

**Fix + regression.** Preserve emptiness: `env := make([]string, len(req.Env)); copy(env, req.Env); cmd.Env = env` (a zero-length `make` result is non-nil → empty child env). Regression tests: the two repro tests above, plus an end-to-end `RunApprovedQACheck` assertion that a parent sentinel does not reach the child.

---

## F2. LOW-MEDIUM / HIGH — Shipped default forwards `PATH`/`HOME` to harness children, contradicting the written contract

CURRENT-CONTRACT violation. docs/configuration.md:230 states: *"The built-in platform set is limited to TMPDIR, LANG, and LC_ALL; PATH and HOME are not forwarded by default."* Reality: config.go:189 and smoke_types.go:55 both default to `[PATH HOME TMPDIR LANG LC_ALL]`, and `TestDefaultSmokeEnvironmentPreservesInterpreterPath` deliberately pins forwarding of PATH and HOME. A harness author or operator relying on the documented guarantee gets `HOME` (→ `.netrc`, `.gitcookies`, cloud-CLI configs) and `PATH` injected into external harness processes. Also widens F1's smoke-side blast radius relative to what docs promise. Fix: pick one truth — align defaults to the doc set, or rewrite the doc sentence — and update the pinning test to match the decision.

## F3. LOW / HIGH — Dispatcher goroutine leak when spawn fails while `Progress` is set

process.go:97 creates the dispatcher (starting its sink goroutine) before `cmd.Start()`; the Start-error return at process.go:101-103 never calls `dispatch.close()`. With `Progress != nil` — which the smoke run invocation always sets (smoke.go:150) — each failed spawn (executable vanished between prepare and spawn, ENOEXEC, etc.) strands one goroutine blocked forever on `range d.ch` plus its buffered channel. In serve/operation-runner mode with repeated retries this accumulates. (No fd leak: Go ≥1.20 closes parent pipes on Start failure.) Fix: `defer`-style close on the early-return paths, or create the dispatcher after a successful Start.

## F4. LOW / MEDIUM-HIGH — Unbounded resource consumption when hashing external evidence

validateSmokeRun hashes every declared evidence file via `hashFile` (smoke.go:363, 707-713) with **no size bound and no non-regular-file guard**, while this codebase's own identity hashing bounds reads at 64 MiB/file (verify.go:433-435). A multi-GiB sparse file inside the runs/issues root → `os.ReadFile` loads it fully → OOM of the ultraplan process mid-validation; a FIFO inside a declared root → `os.ReadFile` blocks forever while the sprint mutation lease is held. Framing honestly: the review-gated harness is semi-trusted and could squander resources directly, so this is robustness rather than privilege escalation — but it converts harness bugs/misbehavior into parent-process failure during a phase that should fail closed gracefully. Fix: stat-and-bound before read (mirror verify.go's 64 MiB rule) and reject non-regular files.

## F5. LOW / HIGH — Web/durable-operation door drops smoke-timeout parse errors and the 24 h cap

The CLI enforces `--timeout` positivity and ≤24 h with a hard error (sprint_commands.go, `parseSprintSmokeArgs`). The operation-runner door does neither: operation_runner.go:82-84 executes `timeout, _ = time.ParseDuration(req.Timeout)` — a malformed value silently becomes 0 and falls through `smokeTimeout` precedence (request > setting > manifest ≤24h > default, smoke_protocol.go:644-657), so the operator's intended cap is silently discarded; a valid-but-huge value (`"999999h"`) is accepted uncapped because the `request` branch of `smokeTimeout` applies no ceiling. Either way the mutation lease is held for far longer than the user believed. Fix: propagate parse errors and apply the same 24 h ceiling as the CLI.

---

## Defended / non-issues (checked, not reporting as defects)

- **Post-SIGKILL indefinite wait (D-state child)** — unix `stopAndWait` blocks on `<-waited` after group-KILL (process_unix.go:31-34); a child stuck in uninterruptible I/O delays return despite elapsed timeout. Inherent to any Wait-after-KILL ladder; the alternative (abandoning Wait) loses exit status and zombie reaping. Accepted tradeoff, correctly surfaced via `CleanupAttempted`.
- **Dead intersection logic in `smokeEnvironment`** — manifest-declared names can never add anything (they're appended only if already in `settings.Environment`, which seeds the slice). Fails closed; matches the seam contract "admitted only if already allowlisted." Redundant, not harmful.
- **`Getpgid`-failure cleanup-incomplete path** — near-unreachable on unix (a zombie retains its pgid until reaped), and its failure direction (`CleanupComplete=false`) is fail-closed.
- **QA approved-check authorization chain** — investigator-supplied refs must match map-owned `ID`+SHA-256 canonical-JSON fingerprint (qa_prompt.go:244-258), descriptor is revalidated under frozen budgets, drift detection wraps execution, raw streams are discarded post-digest. Deterministic encoder (struct-order JSON, HTML escaping off) keeps fingerprints stable. No injection path from LLM output into argv/env/executable.
- **Arg policy ordering** — metachar rejection precedes the flag skip (qa_prompt.go:104-113), so `-d$(...)`-style arguments are rejected despite starting with `-`; write-mode denylist covers gofmt's only mutating flags.
- **Protocol hygiene** — single-JSON-object decoding rejects trailing values (smoke.go:625-637); discovery/run stdout truncation fails closed; executed-test-set equality, count arithmetic, evidence containment/hash/run-ID addressing, and unexplained-exit rejection all hold as coded.
- **Non-unix lane** (`process_other.go`) — `(nil, false)` cleanup-incomplete return is unpinned by tests, but it maps to the fail-closed `cleanup` error category; platform targets linux/darwin.

F1 is the load-bearing result: it invalidates the surface's two headline guarantees (explicit-env-only, allowlist-bounded child capability) and is proven by execution, not inference.
